 The order of competition for the four contestants in the 2026 Road to Olympia Finals has been revealed.
 Thanh Vinh • October 29, 2026 15:14 The four most outstanding contestants have completed the draw for their starting positions, ready for the Grand Final of the 26th season of "Road to Olympia," which will be broadcast live on VTV3.
 At noon on October 29th, at the studio of Vietnam Television, the organizers of the "Road to Olympia" program conducted a draw to determine the starting order for the four contestants participating in the 2026 Final.
 Results of the starting position draw
 The draw process was transparent, clearly determining the standing order at the competition podiums throughout the crucial parts of the final round. The specific results are announced as follows:
 Position number 1: Candidate Nguyen Huy Quang Minh (Thai Binh Specialized High School, Hung Yen province).
 Position number 2: Candidate Doan Le Anh Duc (Hanoi - Amsterdam High School for Gifted Students, Hanoi City).
 Position number 3: Candidate Tran Vo Gia Bao (Le Quy Don Specialized High School - Dong Hai, Khanh Hoa province).
 Position number 4: Candidate Ly Thai Duong (Hung Vuong Specialized High School, Phu Tho province).
 Ready for the decisive match
 Having gone through intense weekly, monthly, and quarterly rounds, all four top contestants have meticulously prepared in terms of knowledge and unique strategies. Completing the draw for their positions allowed the contestants to be more proactive in setting their mindset before the bell rang.
 At noon on October 29th, MC Khánh Vy and the contestants completed the draw for their competition positions. The final round of the 26th season of the "Road to Olympia" competition is scheduled to take place at 8:30 AM on Sunday, November 1st. The program will be broadcast live on VTV3, streamed on the national digital platform VTVgo, and live-streamed on VTV Online.
